text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both slightly down on the day in a narrow range, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral (51) but has weakened over the past week, indicating some erosion of optimism, while Bitcoin's dominance at 58.5% reflects steady interest in the major asset amid modest overall volume of $94B. The broader market is treading water—not panic-selling, but also not rushing to accumulate.
